title: Photo-to-Blender paste pipeline for real-world previz
summary: Minimal X post describing a two-step pipeline: photograph the real world, then paste it into Blender 3D. Thin capture but documents a reusable previz step for grounding 3D scenes in real-world reference.
question_it_answers: What is the simplest photo-to-Blender reference workflow for previz?

claims.text: Workflow is photograph the real world then paste into Blender 3D.

Paste it into Blender 3D
